items.headline: U.S. Futures Fall Amid Geopolitical Tensions and Inflation Worries
items.summary: U.S. stock futures fell Tuesday, continuing Monday's downward trend, as escalating U.S.-Iran tensions pushed oil prices higher and rekindled inflation concerns. This geopolitical uncertainty, coupled with rising long-term Treasury yields and signs of weaker consumer spending, pressured risk appetite across global equities.

items.headline: Flexsteel Industries Surges on Strong Earnings
items.summary: Flexsteel Industries shares jumped 10% after the company surpassed FQ4 earnings and revenue estimates and provided an upbeat Q1 sales guidance.

items.headline: Cerebras Systems Rallies on AI Demand
items.summary: Cerebras Systems saw a 15.07% increase following analyst highlights of strong earnings and growing demand for its AI hardware.

items.headline: Argenx Jumps on Positive Drug Trial Results
items.summary: Argenx shares rose 17.1% after its drug successfully met the primary endpoint in a Phase 3 autoimmune myositis study.

items.headline: SIG Group Slumps on CEO Change
items.summary: SIG Group experienced a 17.6% decline following an unexpected change in its chief executive.

items.headline: Reddit Falls Amid Mixed Outlook
items.summary: Reddit shares fell 7.63% as a price target increase was accompanied by concerns over mixed user engagement and AI headwinds.

items.headline: Carvana Drops on New Loan Facility Details
items.summary: Carvana declined 7.28% after details emerged regarding a new US$1.66 billion term loan B facility.

items.headline: Key Economic Data Released Today
items.summary: Investors are closely watching today's economic calendar, which includes the release of July import and export prices, industrial production, and housing starts data. The ADP National Employment Report indicated that U.S. private employers added an average of 9,500 jobs per week for the four weeks ending August 1, 2026. The Atlanta Fed's GDPNow model for Q3 growth has been revised down by nearly two percentage points since early August, now standing above 4%.

items.headline: Treasury Yields Climb as Fed Hike Odds Shift
items.summary: The U.S. 30-year Treasury yield reached a fresh 19-year high above 5.30%, with the 10-year yield trading near 4.73%. Futures markets are currently pricing in a 36.6% likelihood of the Federal Reserve hiking interest rates during its September meeting, reflecting ongoing inflation concerns.

items.headline: Oil Prices Surge on Heightened Middle East Tensions
items.summary: Brent crude climbed above $91 a barrel, with WTI crude near $84.93, as the U.S.-Iran ceasefire expired and President Trump expressed disinterest in an extension. Renewed tensions and threats of a 'fully offensive' military posture from Iran have heightened fears over energy supplies and potential disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz, driving crude prices higher and exacerbating inflation worries.

items.headline: Major Companies Report Earnings
items.summary: Home Depot ($HD) is among the key companies scheduled to report earnings before the market open today, offering insights into the housing-linked consumer sector. Baidu ($BIDU) announced its Q2 2026 results, with AI Cloud Infra revenue up 50% year-over-year and GPU Cloud revenue increasing by 283%, signaling strong momentum in AI-driven growth.

items.headline: Technology Dominance Wanes, Industrials Gain Momentum
items.summary: While Technology remains the top sector, its dominance has decreased from 70% to 50% recently. Financials and Healthcare sectors are showing signs of improvement, while Industrials have entered the top five, indicating improving momentum. Conversely, the Real Estate sector continues to struggle.
